rca_of_issue: No product defect. The freeze-guard bug class (any successful path to bump v25 through the public API) does not exist: all four unauthorized/misconfigured paths return the correct status codes (401/409/403), and both authorized-but-frozen paths (matching + conflicting rules) return 409 with detail.code='BUNDLE_FROZEN'. The check runs before rule-content validation, so even a semantically invalid attacker payload cannot bypass or trigger a different code path. Bundle version invariant (v25) is preserved through the full test run and re-verified at the end via GET /api/rules/gd-m1-controlled-block/latest -> {bundleVersion:25, keyId:'gd-m1-test-ed25519-001', payloadHash:'2581666cc768e1e4e76962db0cc70e497e17e9b9cf4a5a997c8cfb091e6b90c9'}.
